<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will assume a generic flavanone product SMILES (O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1). Using this SMILES, I will search the template catalog with the functional groups broken (ketones, aromatic hydroxyls) and formed (ether oxygens), and the bonds formed (C-C, C-O) and broken (C-O) as described.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
